title: DDSketch Pipeline Evaluation Report
description: Combined pipeline results, SLO compliance analysis, and configuration benchmark evaluation

windows.description: Map from window_id (string '0'..'19') to window results

total_count.description: Number of values ingested in this window across all hosts

quantiles.description: Uncollapsed DDSketch quantile estimates keyed by quantile level

anomalies.description: Detected anomalous windows based on p99 relative change exceeding the configured threshold

max_buckets_used.description: Peak bucket count across all uncollapsed merged window sketches

collapsed_max_buckets_used.description: Peak bucket count across all collapsed merged window sketches

total_values_ingested.description: Total number of latency values processed

target_p99_ms.description: SLO target for p99 latency in milliseconds, from config.yaml

ewma_decay.description: EWMA decay factor for compliance smoothing, from config.yaml

overall_compliance_pct.description: Percentage of windows meeting the SLO target (100 * compliant_count / total_windows)

windows.description: Per-window SLO compliance details keyed by window_id string ('0'..'19')

p99.description: Pipeline's p99 estimate for this window (from the pipeline report)

compliant.description: True if this window's p99 is at or below target_p99_ms, false otherwise

breach_severity.description: 0.0 if compliant. For non-compliant windows: (p99 - target_p99_ms) / target_p99_ms

ewma_score.description: EWMA-smoothed compliance score after processing this window. Initialized at 1.0 before the first window. Updated per window in sequential order (window 0, 1, ..., 19): ewma = decay * indicator + (1 - decay) * prev_ewma, where indicator is 1.0 if this window's p99 <= target_p99_ms and 0.0 otherwise. Round to 4 decimal places.

breach_windows.description: List of window_ids where p99 exceeded the SLO target, in ascending order

configurations_tested.description: Total number of (alpha, max_buckets) configurations evaluated

results.description: Accuracy and memory results for each tested configuration

max_buckets.description: Configured maximum bucket count for collapsing

max_relative_error.description: Worst-case relative error across ALL windows and ALL quantile levels (0.5, 0.9, 0.95, 0.99)

mean_relative_error.description: Average relative error across all windows and all quantile levels

memory_buckets.description: Peak number of buckets actually used across all merged window sketches (after collapsing)

p99_max_relative_error.description: Worst-case relative error specifically for the p99 quantile across all windows. Isolates tail-latency accuracy from overall error. DDSketch's low-end collapsing preserves tail accuracy, so this value should remain close to alpha even when overall max_relative_error is elevated by low-quantile degradation.

pareto_optimal.description: Configurations not dominated on (p99_max_relative_error, memory_buckets). A configuration is Pareto-optimal if no other tested configuration has both lower-or-equal p99_max_relative_error AND lower-or-equal memory_buckets with strict improvement on at least one dimension. Uses p99 error (not overall error) because tail-quantile accuracy is the primary concern for latency monitoring — DDSketch's collapsing is specifically designed to preserve this property.

recommendation.description: Recommended configuration: the Pareto-optimal config with the lowest p99_max_relative_error. Tail-quantile accuracy is prioritized for latency SLO compliance.
